notes: Builder overhaul: BASE / SHIP / STATION tabs, each with its own parts, start button and status. Station modules: corridors (straight, corner, T, cross), end caps, window cap, airlock, room, observation room, docking arm, hangar bay, power room and solar array - whole sections in one click on a 4 m grid, so they meet doorway to doorway. Your saved designs can be stamped the same way. Stations and bases run one power grid: no cables to lay. Ship consoles: the screen now faces its chair, clean gauges, and screen focus hides your own arms.
